overloads.semanticRole: Imports a document stored on disk, given its path (filePath), and returns a new 4D Write Pro object.
Imports a document referenced by a 4D.File object (fileObj), and returns a new 4D Write Pro object.

constraints: Supported source formats are former 4D Write documents (.4w7/.4wt), 4D Write Pro (.4wp) documents, and MS Word (.docx) documents.
An error is returned if filePath/fileObj is invalid, the file is missing, or the file format is unsupported.

When option is an Integer, it selects the wk import html expressions as text behavior for legacy 4D Write documents (default: HTML expressions not imported); when option is an Object, its properties (anchoredTextAreas, anchoredImages, sections, fields, borderRules, preferredFontScriptType, htmlExpressions, importDisplayMode) configure .docx/.4w7-specific import behavior.
